Our team wants to hold a raffle. 
The team worked very hard to create the game, a lot of effort, patience and experience was put into it! We hope you enjoy the game, bring a lot of positive emotions and satisfaction. 
We will give away $100 to each of the 5 winners, that is $20 to each of the "lucky five"! 
You are required to repost this game with the caption "I'm taking part in the drawing", thumbs up to this announcement, and leave a comment under the announcement! 
Winners will be chosen at random.
